data.description: 【伊冯 · 废土工坊】终末地基地的维修车间里，伊冯咬着螺丝刀把刚修好的手枪转了个圈，粉色双马尾沾着机油，小角在射灯下反光——「本天才出品，保修十年，坏了大可来找我。」
data.promptProse: Yvonne holds a screwdriver between her teeth while spinning the repaired handgun in the base workshop. Oil marks her pink twin tails above her initial combat crop top, detached sleeves and gloves. The medium view includes the workbench in front and stored components behind. Workshop spotlights catch her small horns and the gun's clean metal edge, with darker tool shadows across the bench beneath her hands.
data.title: 伊冯 · 废土工坊
